mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with perphenazine (antipsychotic) increases risk of hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and excessive CNS depression through additive monoamine potentiation and anticholinergic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest doses with careful monitoring of blood pressure, mental status, and for serotonergic symptoms; consider alternative antipsychotic with lower interaction potential.
